TZA.note: ISO member page states nothing on a national data policy.

facts.fact: The ISO member page lists the Tanzania Bureau of Standards as a member body of ISO, with 42 technical committees as participating member and 148 as observing member.

TZA.note: ISO member page states nothing on government interoperability standards.

facts.fact: The ISO member page says the Tanzania Bureau of Standards was established by the Standards Act of 1975, operational from 6 April 1976, with responsibility for formulating standards.
